description: Address 5 semantic review issues: memoize search modal questions, build Map for revision planner lookups, memoize mistake book retry badge count, cap formula quiz localStorage at 1000 entries, unify insights weights with shared config.
steps: In search-modal.tsx, add useMemo import and memoize loadAllQuestions() at component level instead of calling it inside the search callback.
In revision-planner.tsx, build a Map<string, Question> via useMemo from allQuestions and use it for O(1) lookups instead of allQuestions.find().
In mistake-book.tsx, memoize the unique question count for filtered mistakes into a useMemo variable and reference that in the Retry button badge.
In formula-quiz-engine.ts, add a rolling cap of 1000 entries in saveFormulaQuizResult - trim oldest entries before saving if array exceeds 1000.
In insights-content.tsx, import CFA_CURRICULUM_WEIGHTS from shared config and replace the hardcoded weights object, multiplying by 100 for the display calculation.
Run bun run tsc --noEmit and bun run vitest --run to verify.
acceptance_criteria: search-modal.tsx calls loadAllQuestions() in a useMemo, not inside the search handler
revision-planner.tsx uses a Map for question lookups instead of .find()
mistake-book.tsx has a memoized unique question count for the retry badge
insights-content.tsx imports CFA_CURRICULUM_WEIGHTS and uses it instead of hardcoded weights
bun run vitest --run passes (same as before)
verification: Run: bun run tsc --noEmit - expect exit 0
Run: bun run vitest --run - expect same pass count
